role.en: Co-founder & CPO, Cursor (Anysphere) — a SpaceXAI subsidiary
role.zh: Cursor（Anysphere）联合创始人兼 CPO —— SpaceXAI 子公司

why.en: The principal designer of Cursor's product experience and the key mover behind fusing code completion with agent mode — the interaction pattern the rest of the category copied.
why.zh: Cursor 产品体验的主要设计者，代码补全与 Agent 模式融合方案的关键推动者 —— 这一交互范式后来被整个品类复制。

title.en: Cursor Agent mode
title.zh: Cursor Agent 模式

note.en: Fusing completion with agentic edit — the interaction pattern the rest of the category copied.
note.zh: 把补全与 agentic 编辑融合 —— 这一交互范式后来被整个品类复制。

title.en: Grateful to join such a cool company! So much more to do to become The full-stack AI company building the best products, models and the most compute.
title.zh: Grateful to join such a cool company! So much more to do to become The full-stack AI company building the best products, models and the most compute.

note.en: Posted about joining a new company, expressing excitement to help build 'the full-stack AI company' across products, models and compute — marks an employment change.
note.zh: 发文表示很高兴加入一家新公司,称其目标是成为在产品、模型和算力方面全面领先的'全栈AI公司'——标志着一次工作变动。

title.en: This is the first model that I personally prefer over Opus when I am iterating with a single agent. Fast Grok 4.5 feels very very good! The model always finds i
title.zh: This is the first model that I personally prefer over Opus when I am iterating with a single agent. Fast Grok 4.5 feels very very good! The model always finds i

note.en: Said Grok 4.5 is the first model he personally prefers over Claude Opus for single-agent coding iteration, citing its ability to work around roadblocks.
note.zh: 表示Grok 4.5是他在单智能体编码迭代中第一次觉得比Claude Opus更好用的模型,称其能很好地绕过看似棘手的障碍。

title.en: Programmatic access to the frontier intelligence of Composer 2.5 with the cursor sdk!
title.zh: Programmatic access to the frontier intelligence of Composer 2.5 with the cursor sdk!

note.en: Announced programmatic access to Composer 2.5 via the Cursor SDK, extending the model's reach beyond the editor.
note.zh: 宣布可通过Cursor SDK以编程方式访问Composer 2.5模型,将该模型的使用范围扩展到编辑器之外。

title.en: Big model coming soon ... !
title.zh: Big model coming soon ... !

note.en: Teased an upcoming large model release, a post that drew unusually high engagement for his usual reach.
note.zh: 预告即将发布的大模型,该帖子获得了远超他平时水平的关注度。

title.en: We've gotten really really good at RL. Composer 2.5 is fighting well-above its weight class. Very excited for the next release as we scale model sizes and FLOPs
title.zh: We've gotten really really good at RL. Composer 2.5 is fighting well-above its weight class. Very excited for the next release as we scale model sizes and FLOPs

note.en: Said Cursor has gotten very good at RL, with Composer 2.5 punching above its weight, and previewed further scaling of model size and compute.
note.zh: 表示Cursor在强化学习方面已取得很大进步,Composer 2.5表现超出其规模预期,并预告将继续扩大模型规模和算力投入。

title.en: A conversation with @sirupsen on scaling Shopify, building turbopuffer, and the future of databases. 0:00 - Scaling Shopify through flash sales and outages 8:13
title.zh: A conversation with @sirupsen on scaling Shopify, building turbopuffer, and the future of databases. 0:00 - Scaling Shopify through flash sales and outages 8:13

note.en: Shared a conversation with turbopuffer's Simon Eskildsen (@sirupsen) covering scaling Shopify, building turbopuffer, and the future of databases.
note.zh: 分享了与turbopuffer创始人Simon Eskildsen(@sirupsen)的对谈,内容涉及Shopify的扩展、turbopuffer的构建以及数据库的未来。

title.en: Model, runtime, and interface. We are a new type of company that builds great product and make good models!
title.zh: Model, runtime, and interface. We are a new type of company that builds great product and make good models!

note.en: Positioned Cursor/Anysphere as a new kind of company spanning model, runtime and interface, building both great products and models.
note.zh: 将Cursor/Anysphere定位为一种新型公司,同时覆盖模型、运行时和交互界面,既做出色的产品也做出色的模型。

title.en: Composer 2 is our first model where the intelligence is truly at the frontier-level. As we scale our compute and pretraining + RL stack, you should continue to
title.zh: Composer 2 is our first model where the intelligence is truly at the frontier-level. As we scale our compute and pretraining + RL stack, you should continue to

note.en: Said Composer 2 is Cursor's first model with truly frontier-level intelligence, and previewed continued scaling of pretraining and RL.
note.zh: 表示Composer 2是Cursor第一款达到真正前沿水平智能的模型,并预告将继续扩大预训练和强化学习的投入。

title.en: most excited about all the perf work we did to make LSP perf be excellent in 2.0!
title.zh: most excited about all the perf work we did to make LSP perf be excellent in 2.0!

note.en: Highlighted performance work that made LSP (language server) latency excellent in Cursor 2.0.
note.zh: 介绍了使Cursor 2.0中LSP(语言服务器)性能表现优异的相关优化工作。

title.en: 0.50 is a really big release! The new tab model is an OOM better at jumps and the cursor agent can run in the background. You can interact with your agents imme
title.zh: 0.50 is a really big release! The new tab model is an OOM better at jumps and the cursor agent can run in the background. You can interact with your agents imme

note.en: Called Cursor 0.50 a major release: an order-of-magnitude better tab model and a background-capable Cursor agent reachable remotely.
note.zh: 称Cursor 0.50是一次重大更新:Tab模型的跳转能力提升了一个数量级,且Cursor agent可在后台运行并可远程交互。

title.en: Codebase indexing has gotten significantly better on @cursor_ai: size: 1M+ files / 1B+ lines of code warm indexes: initialization 12-20x faster with ~ instant s
title.zh: Codebase indexing has gotten significantly better on @cursor_ai: size: 1M+ files / 1B+ lines of code warm indexes: initialization 12-20x faster with ~ instant s

note.en: Detailed major codebase indexing improvements on Cursor: handling 1M+ files/1B+ lines, with 12-20x faster warm-index initialization.
note.zh: 详细介绍了Cursor代码库索引的重大改进:支持超过100万文件、10亿行代码,热索引初始化速度提升12-20倍。

title.en: Inside Cursor: The future of AI coding with Co-founder Sualeh Asif
title.zh: Inside Cursor: The future of AI coding with Co-founder Sualeh Asif

note.en: Long-form Gradient Dissent interview in which Asif explains how Cursor's editor was built and how completion and agent mode were fused into one interaction model.
note.zh: 《Gradient Dissent》长篇访谈，Asif 讲述 Cursor 编辑器的构建过程，以及如何把代码补全与智能体模式融合成同一种交互方式。

title.en: Configurable thinking out soon! 👀 https://t.co/ojKYqT0wXN
title.zh: Configurable thinking out soon! 👀 https://t.co/ojKYqT0wXN

note.en: Teased an upcoming 'configurable thinking' feature; the post drew engagement well above his usual scale.
note.zh: 预告即将推出的'可配置思考'功能,该帖子获得的关注度远超他平时的水平。

title.en: Cursor🤝Supermaven == New research and magical product features coming soon!
title.zh: Cursor🤝Supermaven == New research and magical product features coming soon!

note.en: Announced Cursor's partnership/acquisition of Supermaven, teasing new research and product features to come.
note.zh: 宣布Cursor与Supermaven达成合作/收购,预告即将推出的新研究和产品功能。

title.en: #447 – Cursor Team: Future of Programming with AI
title.zh: #447 – Cursor Team: Future of Programming with AI

note.en: Sualeh Asif joined fellow Cursor co-founders Aman Sanger, Arvid Lunnemark and Michael Truell on the Lex Fridman Podcast to discuss the future of AI-assisted programming.
note.zh: Sualeh Asif与Cursor联合创始人Aman Sanger、Arvid Lunnemark和Michael Truell一同做客Lex Fridman播客，探讨AI辅助编程的未来。

title.en: Plan: build the tool that builds all the worlds software. We will continue to focus all of our energy on hardcore engineering and research.
title.zh: Plan: build the tool that builds all the worlds software. We will continue to focus all of our energy on hardcore engineering and research.

note.en: Asif states Cursor's mission as building 'the tool that builds all the world's software,' with the team focused on engineering and research.
note.zh: Asif阐述Cursor的使命是打造"构建全世界软件的工具"，团队将全力投入硬核工程与研究。

title.en: our new brand is out now on https://t.co/2rBxfxqe7Y. https://t.co/PJIgWvnhkH
title.zh: our new brand is out now on https://t.co/2rBxfxqe7Y. https://t.co/PJIgWvnhkH

note.en: Asif announces Cursor's new brand launch.
note.zh: Asif宣布Cursor完成品牌焕新并正式上线。

title.en: Copilot++ is really the best inflow coding experience out there. its incredibly fast now.
title.zh: Copilot++ is really the best inflow coding experience out there. its incredibly fast now.

note.en: Asif praises Copilot++, Cursor's fast in-flow coding feature, calling it the best experience of its kind.
note.zh: Asif称赞Cursor的Copilot++功能是同类中最出色的沉浸式编程体验，且速度极快。

title.en: Really happy that coding copilots will transition from only writing net new code to actually helping you do software-engineering. Like do real edits in your cod
title.zh: Really happy that coding copilots will transition from only writing net new code to actually helping you do software-engineering. Like do real edits in your cod

note.en: Asif welcomes the shift of coding copilots from pure code generation toward real software-engineering assistance — doing edits and understanding context.
note.zh: Asif对编程助手从单纯生成代码转向真正协助软件工程（进行编辑并理解上下文）的趋势表示欢迎。

title.en: SpaceX closes the $60B acquisition of Anysphere
title.zh: SpaceX 完成 600 亿美元收购 Anysphere

body.en: Forbes estimated each Cursor co-founder received SpaceX shares worth about $2.4B at closing.
body.zh: 《福布斯》估算交割时每位 Cursor 联合创始人获得价值约 24 亿美元的 SpaceX 股票。

title.en: Karachi-Born Sualeh Asif Becomes Pakistan’s Youngest Billionaire at 26
title.zh: Karachi-Born Sualeh Asif Becomes Pakistan’s Youngest Billionaire at 26

body.en: Sualeh Asif became Pakistan's youngest billionaire at 26, following the surge in Cursor's valuation.
body.zh: 随着Cursor估值飙升，苏艾雷·阿西夫在26岁时成为巴基斯坦最年轻的亿万富翁。

title.en: Elon Musk’s SpaceX Snaps Up Sualeh Asif’s AI Startup Cursor for $60 Billion
title.zh: Elon Musk’s SpaceX Snaps Up Sualeh Asif’s AI Startup Cursor for $60 Billion

body.en: SpaceX acquired Cursor, which Asif co-founded, in a deal valued at about $60 billion.
body.zh: SpaceX 以约600亿美元收购了 Sualeh Asif 联合创办的 Cursor。

title.en: Elon Musk’s $60 billion Cursor deal makes Indian-origin Aman Sanger, Pakistan-born Sualeh Asif $2.7 billion richer
title.zh: Elon Musk’s $60 billion Cursor deal makes Indian-origin Aman Sanger, Pakistan-born Sualeh Asif $2.7 billion richer

body.en: A $60 billion deal tied to Elon Musk's investment in Cursor reportedly made co-founders Aman Sanger and Sualeh Asif billionaires, a major valuation milestone for the company Asif helped build as CPO.
body.zh: 据报道，埃隆·马斯克对Cursor的600亿美元交易使联合创始人Aman Sanger和Sualeh Asif成为亿万富翁，这是Asif作为首席产品官参与打造的公司迎来的重大估值里程碑。

title.en: PIEAS alumnus Sualeh Asif all set for $60bn deal with Musk’s SpaceX
title.zh: PIEAS alumnus Sualeh Asif all set for $60bn deal with Musk’s SpaceX

body.en: Reports SpaceX's $60bn acquisition of Cursor's parent Anysphere, which puts Asif's company and his own role under Musk's group.
body.zh: 报道 SpaceX 以 600 亿美元收购 Cursor 母公司 Anysphere，Asif 的公司与其本人的职务由此归入马斯克旗下集团。

title.en: PIEAS alumnus Sualeh Asif all set for $60bn deal with Musk’s SpaceX
title.zh: PIEAS alumnus Sualeh Asif all set for $60bn deal with Musk’s SpaceX

body.en: Reports say Cursor co-founder Sualeh Asif is set to fold Cursor (Anysphere) into Musk's SpaceX in a roughly $60 billion deal, a major corporate restructuring for the company.
body.zh: 报道称Cursor联合创始人Sualeh Asif即将促成一笔约600亿美元的交易，将Cursor（Anysphere）并入马斯克旗下SpaceX，这是公司的一次重大重组。

title.en: Pakistani AI entrepreneur Sualeh Asif makes it to Forbes' global billionaires list
title.zh: Pakistani AI entrepreneur Sualeh Asif makes it to Forbes' global billionaires list

body.en: Cursor co-founder Sualeh Asif was named to Forbes' global billionaires list, reflecting Anysphere's soaring valuation.
body.zh: Cursor联合创始人Sualeh Asif登上福布斯全球亿万富豪榜，反映出Anysphere估值的飙升。

title.en: Pakistan-born Sualeh Asif’s startup Cursor in reported $60bn deal with Elon Musk’s SpaceX
title.zh: Pakistan-born Sualeh Asif’s startup Cursor in reported $60bn deal with Elon Musk’s SpaceX

body.en: Cursor, the startup Asif co-founded, was reported to be in a $60 billion deal with Elon Musk's SpaceX.
body.zh: 阿西夫联合创立的Cursor被曝正与马斯克旗下SpaceX进行一笔600亿美元的交易。
